allowed_before_execution: feature availability audit without target outcomes
freeze input schema and source receipts

scientific_question: Do repeated physical-event representation and already-active persistence materially change measured 24-hour SEP occurrence skill when predictions are fixed prospectively?

issue_protocol.prediction_deadline: prediction and alert must be append-only and timestamped no later than issue_time

feature_availability_gate.execution_requirement: every model input must be VERIFIED_CAUSAL before model freeze; no feature may rely on future publication, retrospective catalogue boundaries, or later backfill

bootstrap.pairing: one shared resample of physical episode and quiet-block units per replicate reused across all eligible models, evaluation views, and contrasts

information_floor.note: This floor was chosen before protected counts were inspected and is a design floor, not a power guarantee.

confirmation_rule.minimum_requirement: information floor met and required past-proton persistence interval strictly below zero
confirmation_rule.stronger_model_based_confirmation: if joint_operational_model was frozen before outcome access, both joint directional intervals must also be reported regardless of sign; no model slot may be added after outcome access
confirmation_rule.failure_rule: if the information floor is not met or the required interval includes or exceeds zero, do not claim prospective confirmation

development_side_receives: aggregate cohort counts after analysis freeze

claim_boundary.allowed_if_confirmed: prospective evidence that occurrence scoring and causal onset scoring measure materially different behavior under the frozen protocol
not_allowed: universal bias across all SEP literature
